ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 80% high-intensity (white) pixels in central lobe regions with 20% low-intensity (black) pixels concentrated on margins and linear streaks.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity white interior. Low-intensity black pigmentation forms a continuous serrated boundary along the trailing edge. Distinct, sub-parallel black linear streaks (rake-like) are mapped on the medial portion of the left lobe and the distal portion of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude sawtooth serrations along the visible trailing edge boundary; amplitude varies between 3-8 pixels in depth relative to the linear lobe axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature sweep on both left and right lobes, tapering to acute distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Four distinct high-contrast linear black streaks on the inner-left lobe and three on the outer-right lobe, oriented roughly perpendicular to the leading edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Healed rake marks (linear pigmentation disruptions) visible on the ventral surfaces of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: A single circular low-intensity focal spot is visible on the interior ventral surface of the right lobe.
